raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Lessons from the PR 28185 explainer video (int8 checkpoint pool for the linear-attn prefix cache).

- **pronounce.py**: `TOKEN` now absorbs leading / trailing underscores. Before, `_commit_int8_checkpoint` left its `_` in the spoken text and the voice said 「下划线 commit int8 checkpoint」 (pron_check heard it on the recorded take). `__init__` → `init`. Regression test added in `tests/test_explainer_pronounce.py`.
- **captions patch**:
  - `LATIN_EDGE` includes `_`, so 「新增的 _free_mamba_value」 keeps its space in the caption line.
  - Displayed word text gets a thin space between `%` and CJK punctuation: in the serif caption 「0.7%。」 read as ‰ (QA finding). Group text keys are unchanged, so translations still match.
  - That hunk now carries trailing context; without it `git apply` only matches a hunk at end of file.
- **pronunciation.md**: rule 1 notes the underscore fix; reword table gains `config` (看Fake for config / Config / con fig / kon fig; configuration passes → narration says 模型配置) and `flush` (heard Flash in context → narration describes the clear instead).
- **worker-dispatch.md**: − and × stay in Inter / JetBrains Mono / EB Garamond (all carry them). Forcing them into a Noto Sans SC span dropped negative numbers 3–4 px below their row.

Tests: `pytest tests/test_explainer_pronounce.py` (16 passed); pre-commit clean; the patch applies to the pinned HyperFrames commit.

files.patch:
@@ -27,7 +27,9 @@ voice changes.
 
 1. **Never put `_` in front of the voice.** snake_case and SCREAMING_CASE are read as 下划线. Writing them in
    the narration is fine: the identifier rule splits them and maps known parts (SGLANG_DSA_FUSE_TOPK →
-   SGLang DSA fuse top k). A part that is not a word the voice knows needs a `parts` entry.
+   SGLang DSA fuse top k). A part that is not a word the voice knows needs a `parts` entry. Leading and trailing
+   underscores belong to the identifier (`_commit_int8_checkpoint`, `__init__`): before 2026-10-27 the token
+   started at the first letter, so the voice said 「下划线 commit int8 checkpoint」 (PR 28185 video).
 2. **CamelCase brand names that run words together get spaces:** FlashInfer → Flash Infer, DeepSeek → Deep Seek,
    TensorRT-LLM → Tensor RT LLM. Unspaced, the voice blurs them ("Flesh and Fur", "Deep Seat").
 3. **All-caps words that are English words mostly stay all-caps** (PAGED, EXTEND, DECODE): Xiaoxiao reads them
@@ -138,6 +140,8 @@ worse), Godot (bare form heard "Golded"; "Go dough" was read as Chinese 勾斗,
 | INT32 (accumulator) | 印32 (OK~ in every spelling) | 32 位整数累加 |
 | key (as in 128 个 key 通道, K3 video 2026-10-19) | T (again) | k 的 128 个通道 |
 | e (as in e 的负 80 次方) | 一 | 累积衰减的对数最多到负 80 (keep e<sup>−80</sup> on screen) |
+| config (model config, PR 28185 video 2026-10-27) | 看Fake (config / Config / con fig / kon fig all fail; configuration passes) | 模型配置 (config.json stays on screen) |
+| flush (flush cache, same video) | Flash (in context) | 整个 radix 树被清空时 (flush stays on screen) |
 | tok/s | Talk | 每秒 N 个 token |
 | copy on write | on → 嗯 | 写时复制 (the English stays on screen) |
 | pybind11 (DeepInfer video, 2026-10-20) | PBind11 | 绑定到 Python |

@@ -85,6 +85,10 @@ earlier film. The project's `dispatch.py` keeps the full list.
   no ✗. Workers must write super/subscripts as `<sup>`/`<sub>` (k<sup>T</sup>, e<sup>−80</sup>, β<sub>1</sub>) even
   where the packet writes the Unicode form, and draw ✓ ✗ ⋮ as inline SVG; ¹ ² ³ ⁴ are fine. `subset_fonts.py` now
   warns about any used character no bundled font covers (K3 video: caught after two waves; one caption had ᵀ).
+- Minus and times signs stay in the surrounding font: Inter, JetBrains Mono and EB Garamond all carry − (U+2212)
+  and × (U+00D7). Wrapping them in a "Noto Sans SC" span (the old advice) changes the line box and drops a negative
+  number 3–4 px below its row (PR 28185 video: −0.05 / −20 / −127 sat low in tables and on a number line). Only
+  glyphs the Latin faces lack (→ ≈ ≤ ⁄ ∝ ⊂) need the Noto span.
 - Ligatures: JetBrains Mono turns `==` `!=` `->` `>=` into ligature glyphs. Every mono element (code, kickers,
   paths, commands) sets `font-variant-ligatures:none; font-feature-settings:"liga" 0,"calt" 0`.
 - kimi-dark: tell workers the theme override for `_role.md` (template above); without it they follow the role

 HAN = re.compile(r"[\u4e00-\u9fff]")

     assert spoken("它尤其擅长参数化建模") == "它尤其擅常参数化建模"
     assert spoken("不随上下文变长，长程任务，长篇讲解") == "不随上下文变长，长程任务，长篇讲解"

+

+def test_leading_and_trailing_underscores_stay_with_the_identifier():
+    # PR 28185 video (2026-10-27): TOKEN started at a letter, so the "_" of a private
+    # method stayed in the text and the voice read 「下划线 commit int8 checkpoint」.
+    assert spoken("入口，_commit_int8_checkpoint：先申请") == "入口，commit INT8 checkpoint：先申请"
+    assert spoken("池子在 _init_mamba_pool 里创建") == "池子在 init mamba pool 里创建"
+    assert spoken("__init__ 和 x_y") == "init 和 x y"
+    _, spans = P.to_spoken("新增的 _free_mamba_value，开了")
+    assert [w for *_, w in spans] == ["_free_mamba_value"]
